scripts.docs:build: npm run sync:content -w apps/docs && npm run build -w apps/docs
scripts.db:check: go tool sqlite-migrate check -schema db/schema.sql -dir migrations

scriptDocs.db:check: Fail if a migration file was edited after generation or db/schema.sql drifts from migrations/ (sqlite-migrate check, pinned as a go.mod tool; needs Go, no database). See docs/specs.html#schema-migrations.
